title: Idefinity Feedback
description: NPS feedback submission from the Idefinity desktop application. Schema 1.0 requires app_version and platform; schema 1.1 makes both optional because clients send them only when the user consents (ROK-311).

schema_version.description: Schema version. 1.0: app_version and platform required. 1.1: both optional (omitted without user consent).

app_version.description: Semantic version of the application (Major.Minor.Bug or Major.Minor.Bug.NonRelease). Required in 1.0; in 1.1 sent only with user consent, omitted otherwise.

platform.description: Operating system the feedback was sent from. Required in 1.0; in 1.1 sent only with user consent, omitted otherwise. If present it must be on the server allowlist (ALLOWED_PLATFORMS, default macOS,Windows).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the feedback was submitted

nps_rating.description: Net Promoter Score rating (1 = not likely, 10 = very likely to recommend)

nps_category.description: NPS classification derived from nps_rating: 1-6 = detractor, 7-8 = passive, 9-10 = promoter

timezone.description: IANA timezone name or OS-specific timezone identifier from the user's system

comment.description: Optional free-text feedback from the user

examples.comment: Love the IDEF0 modeling workflow, would like more export formats.
Sent without consent: no app_version or platform.
